'''Eric C. Harshbarger''' (born {{Circa|1971}})<ref>{{cite news |title=Lego's Online Dream |url=https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2001/feb/01/microsoft.news |author=Chloe Veltman |work=The Guardian |date=January 31, 2001 |access-date=August 2, 2016}}</ref> is a Senior Lecturer of mathematics at [[Auburn University]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Mathematics and Statistics Faculty |url=https://www.auburn.edu/cosam/faculty/math_stats/ |website=Auburn Department of Mathematics and Statistics |access-date=3 July 2025}}</ref> He previously was an [[Alabama]]-based builder of large-scale [[Lego]] brick mosaics and sculptures.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Brooks |first1=Brychelle |title=Eric Harshbarger: From Lego builder to lecturer |url=https://www.theplainsman.com/article/2024/05/from-lego-builder-to-lecturer-eric-harshbarger |website=The Auburn Plainsman |access-date=3 July 2025}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |title=Bits to Bricks |url=https://www.latimes.com/archives/la-xpm-2000-dec-14-tt-65262-story.html |work=[[Los Angeles Times]] |date=December 14, 2000 |access-date=August 2, 2016}}</ref> From around 2000 to 2006 he was commissioned to build for [[Television show|television shows]] and [[Magazine|magazines]] for promotional purposes.

== Biography ==
Harshbarger grew up in [[Auburn, Alabama]] where he went to [[Auburn High School (Alabama)|Auburn High School]]. In 1992, he obtained a Bachelor of Science from Auburn University in the Mathematics Department . In 1994, he also received a Master of Science from the Mathematics department at Auburn. In the late 1990s, he moved to California to pursue a job in the computer industry. In 1999, he returned to his home town of Auburn .<ref>{{Cite web |title=COSAM Math Instructor Talks LEGOs®, Puzzles and Scrabble |url=https://www.auburn.edu/cosam/news/articles/2019/02/cosam_math_instructor_talks_legos,_puzzles_and_scrabble.htm |access-date=2025-08-15 |website=www.auburn.edu}}</ref>

== Puzzles and games ==
Harshbarger is also well known for his work in puzzle and game design. His ''Digits in a Box''<ref>{{cite web|last1=Mcdonald|first1=Thomas L.|title=Digits in a Box|url=http://sopgaming.blogspot.com/2011/02/digits-in-box.html|website=State of Play--The Gaming Blog|date=10 February 2011}}</ref> toy has been produced by Popular Playthings since 2007. ''[[Wired (magazine)|Wired]]'' magazine<ref>{{cite magazine|last1=Harshbarger|first1=Eric|title=Test Your Lying Eyes With Shades of Gray|url=https://www.wired.com/2009/04/puzzle7/|magazine=Wired|access-date=17 February 2017}}</ref> featured an optical illusion puzzle of his design in 2009. Collaborating with [[Mike Selinker]], Harshbarger co-authored an optimization puzzle for the ''Maze of Games'' in 2015.<ref>{{cite magazine|last1=Selinker|first1=Mike|title=The Path Found: Solutions to the Maze of Games Campaign Puzzles|url=https://www.wired.com/2013/04/maze-of-games-campaign-solutions/|magazine=Wired|access-date=17 February 2017}}</ref> From 2004-2017 he also has hosted one or more [[Puzzlehunt|puzzle parties]] in and around his hometown of [[Auburn, Alabama]]. <ref>{{cite web|title=Eric's Puzzle Parties|url=http://www.ericharshbarger.org/epp/|website=www.ericharshbarger.org}}</ref> His puzzle TicTac's Tactics won Jury Honorable Mention at the 2018 International [[Nob Yoshigahara Puzzle Design Competition]].<ref>
*[https://puzzleworld.org/DesignCompetition/ Nob Yoshigahara Puzzle Design Competition - Jury Honorable Mention]
*{{Citation|title=International Puzzle Party IPP38 Nob Yoshigahara Puzzle Design Competition 2018 |url = https://themetagrobologist.co.uk/international-puzzle-party-ipp38/ | year = 2018 | publisher = themetagrobologist.co.uk}}</ref>

In the state of Alabama, Eric Harshbarger is ranked number one and is in the top 100 players in the United States for the game ''[[Scrabble]]''.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Brooks |first1=Brychelle |title=Eric Harshbarger: From Lego builder to lecturer |url=https://www.theplainsman.com/article/2024/05/from-lego-builder-to-lecturer-eric-harshbarger |website=The Auburn Plainsman |access-date=3 July 2025}}</ref>

== Mathematics ==
Harshbarger is a senior lecturer in the Department of Mathematics and Statistics at Auburn University.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Eric Harshbarger - Faculty - Mathematics and Statistics - Auburn University College of Sciences and Mathematics |url=https://www.auburn.edu/cosam/faculty/math_stats/instructors/harshbarger/index.htm |access-date=2025-08-15 |website=www.auburn.edu}}</ref> Harshbarger has been credited for significant research, development, and production of [[Go First Dice]].<ref>{{cite web |last1=Harshbarger |first1=Eric |title=Go First Dice |url=http://www.ericharshbarger.org/dice/go_first_dice.html |website=ericharshbarger.org |access-date=3 July 2025}}</ref>
